title: [Lean] Execute encoded exponent alignment and dyadic addition
body:
## Summary

Three unchanged accepted sources execute binary exponent comparison/difference and unary control production, then eleven-tape signed dyadic addition with actual route selection and whole-run prefix storage.

## Author-checked context

κ = 836330098538459/500000000000000000 = 0.001672660197076918, unchanged selected PR1094 context only.

## Scope

Finite full-theorem coverage: actual prepared runs, exact first halt, decoded sum and all-prefix represented-cell bound. Conditional interfaces: four physically encoded inputs, independent blank workspaces and finite control entrances. Numeric exponent-gap cost remains explicit. The common exponent is an original-word view; fresh result record, packed acquisition/writeback and selected root-uniform runtime are outside this unit. The newer fixed-grid reference direction has separate physical encoding/right-shift obligations.

## Evidence and reuse

25 complete standard-only probes, five full printed types and one retained harmless style warning. Three exact sources /41,587 bytes reuse24 immutable public/import-derived prerequisites. Existing generic machine/caller/copy suppliers in PR2235 and PR2411 are acknowledged. No accepted proof replay, source rewrite or generic novelty claim.

## Exact adoption

Publication parent: 0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2. The five selected-result, assembly, selected-source and emitter blobs match the previously checked context exactly; contextual kappa is unchanged. No accepted proof was rerun for this adoption.
